content: <thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the base peak at m/z 183.0451 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈182.0378 Da. The isotopic M+1 intensity (~10 %) points to about 8–9 carbon atoms. A formula that fits both the exact mass and the isotopic pattern is C₈H₈NO₄ (neutral mass 182.04533 Da), which is within a few mDa of the calculated neutral mass and matches the expected carbon count. Therefore the molecular formula is C₈H₈NO₄.
